clients.name: Afinity
clients.shortDescription: A modern, native Android Jellyfin client built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, and LibMPV.
clients.description: ​AFinity is a native Android application that brings your Jellyfin media library to life with a clean, responsive interface. Stream your movies, TV shows, music, and live TV with hardware-accelerated playback, and discover new content through a home screen you can shape yourself. Beyond video, AFinity extends your experience with optional Audiobookshelf integration for audiobooks and podcasts, and direct media requests via Jellyseerr.

clients.name: Coppelia
clients.shortDescription: A native, low-resource Jellyfin client focused on music libraries, built with Flutter for macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux, with offline downloads, smart lists, and deep theming.
clients.description:
Coppelia is a native app built specifically for browsing and playing Jellyfin music libraries, built with Flutter for macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux (Windows is planned). It was built to be native and low-resource rather than a wrapped web view, and to look good while doing it.

It covers fast library browsing and search across albums, artists, genres, and playlists, with full playlist management, gapless playback, and queue controls. macOS gets Now Playing and media key integration, and Android gets lockscreen and notification controls. Offline support goes beyond simple downloads with pinning, a Wi-Fi-aware download manager, and dedicated offline library sections, and Smart Lists let you build self-updating local playlists from rules. Appearance is deeply configurable, down to accent colors, font scale, layout density, and now-playing palette theming.

clients.name: Infuse
clients.shortDescription: A polished, closed-source video player for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac that connects directly to Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby libraries, with hardware-accelerated 4K HDR/Dolby Vision playback, AirPlay/Google Cast, and Trakt sync.
clients.description:
Infuse is a polished, closed-source video player from Firecore for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac. It connects directly to Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby libraries (alongside NAS shares, SMB/WebDAV sources, and cloud storage), pulling in artwork and metadata automatically without any file conversion or transcoding for most formats.

Playback covers a wide range of video, audio, and subtitle formats, with hardware-accelerated 4K HDR, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision, plus Dolby and DTS audio passthrough. AirPlay and Google Cast streaming, two-way Trakt sync for watched history and ratings, and one-click OpenSubtitles downloads round out the free tier. Infuse Pro, available as a subscription or one-time lifetime purchase, unlocks additional formats, cloud storage sources, video trailers, and cross-device library and playback sync.

clients.name: JellyCon
clients.shortDescription: The official lightweight Kodi add-on for browsing and playing Jellyfin media directly within the Kodi interface.
clients.description:
JellyCon is the official lightweight Kodi add-on for Jellyfin. Rather than syncing your library into Kodi's own database, it acts as a thin frontend: movies, TV shows, music videos, and music are populated dynamically straight from the server, so there's no library sync to wait on and content updates on your Jellyfin server show up immediately in Kodi.

It supports Live TV, switches between multiple Jellyfin user accounts on the fly, and logs in with Quick Connect or a manual username and password. Because menus and widgets are exposed through Kodi's own add-on browser, JellyCon can be wired into almost any customizable Kodi skin.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Android
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for Android phones and tablets, wrapping the web client with native audio, video, and casting support.
clients.description:
Jellyfin for Android is the official companion app for phones and tablets. Rather than reimplementing the interface, it wraps the same [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) client used by every server, so browsing, search, and library layout stay identical to what you'd see in a desktop browser, while Android gets native touches on top: local audio and video playback, Chromecast support, notifications, and Quick Connect login.

Because it's a thin wrapper around the web client rather than a fully native rewrite, most fixes and new features land in [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) first and reach this app automatically.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Android TV
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for Android TV, Fire TV, and Nvidia Shield devices.
clients.description:
Jellyfin for Android TV is the official native client for Android TV, Fire TV, and Nvidia Shield, built to be driven entirely with a remote. It plays almost everything your server has without transcoding, using hardware-accelerated decoding with Dolby Vision and 10-bit HEVC support, trickplay scrubbing thumbnails, and both embedded and external subtitle formats including PGS and ASS.

Beyond playback it covers the things a shared living-room device needs: Quick Connect and multiple saved servers, separate user profiles with parental controls and PINs, Live TV with DVR scheduling, and SyncPlay to watch in step with other Jellyfin clients on the network.

clients.name: Jellyfin Desktop
clients.shortDescription: The official desktop client for Jellyfin, built on mpv for high quality local playback.
clients.description: The official Jellyfin desktop client built with Qt WebEngine and [libmpv](https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv). Supports audio passthrough, hardware decoding, and playback of more formats without transcoding.

clients.name: Jellyfin Mobile
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for iPhone and iPad, wrapping the web client with native audio and video playback.
clients.description:
Jellyfin Mobile is the official companion app for iPhone and iPad, built with Expo around the same [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) interface every server ships with. It wraps that web client in a native shell so browsing, search, and library layout match what you'd see in a desktop browser, while iOS gets native audio and video playback, Live TV, and Quick Connect login on top.

Since it's a wrapper rather than a fully native rewrite, this is the app to reach for if you want the exact web experience on a phone; for a from-scratch Swift client built around VLC, see [Swiftfin](/clients/swiftfin) instead.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Kodi
clients.shortDescription: The official Kodi add-on that syncs Jellyfin libraries into Kodi's native database for full-speed browsing with any skin.
clients.description:
Jellyfin for Kodi combines Kodi's fast native navigation and skin support with Jellyfin's metadata and library management. Unlike a plugin-style frontend, it syncs the Jellyfin libraries you choose (movies, TV shows, music videos, and music) straight into Kodi's own database, so browsing runs at full native speed and works with any Kodi skin or add-on that expects a local library.

Other libraries, like simple Live TV, home videos and photos, and playlists, stay available dynamically without syncing. Watched and resume state sync both ways between Kodi and your server in near real time, and you can send play commands to a running Kodi from the Jellyfin web client or mobile apps.

clients.name: Jellyfin MPV Shim
clients.shortDescription: The official cross-platform cast client for Jellyfin, built on MPV for near-universal direct play without transcoding.
clients.description:
Jellyfin MPV Shim is the official cross-platform cast client for Windows, macOS, and Linux, built around the MPV media player to direct play almost any file your server has without transcoding. It can run quietly in the background as a cast target that other Jellyfin apps (including the mobile apps) can control remotely, or act as a fully-featured desktop client on its own, complete with offline sync.

It covers Live TV with channel guides, schedules, and recording rules, SyncPlay for watching together with other clients, Chromecast-like display mirroring, Discord Rich Presence, and configurable shader packs and SVP integration for enhancing video quality. Nearly everything, including MPV itself, can be tuned through its configuration files.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Roku
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for Roku devices, with trickplay, media segment, and song lyric support.
clients.description:
Jellyfin for Roku is the official channel for Roku devices, letting you browse and play movies, TV shows, music, and Live TV without leaving the Roku interface. It supports trickplay scrubbing thumbnails, media segment skipping (intros, credits, and similar), downloading subtitles directly to the device, and song lyrics during music playback.

Note: due to a technical limitation of the Roku store, the listing may state that a cable or satellite subscription is required. No subscription of any kind is needed to use Jellyfin or any official client.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Tizen
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for Samsung Tizen smart TVs, wrapping the web client for the big screen.
clients.description: Jellyfin for Tizen is the official app for Samsung smart TVs. Like the webOS version, it's a native wrapper that bundles the same [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) client every server ships with, so it inherits the web client's browsing and playback features while handling remote input and installation through Samsung's Smart TV App Store.

clients.name: Jellyfin Vue
clients.shortDescription: An official, experimental alternative web client for Jellyfin, rewritten from scratch with Vue.js.
clients.description:
Jellyfin Vue is an official, experimental alternative to the main [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) client, rewritten from scratch with Vue.js. It isn't meant to replace the main web client and isn't feature-complete yet, but it's actively developed and usable today: point it at any Jellyfin server behind a properly configured HTTPS reverse proxy, or try it against Jellyfin's public demo server.

You can use the hosted build, self-host it with the provided Docker images, or bundle it as a local desktop app; in every case it only ever talks to the Jellyfin server you point it to, the same privacy model as the main web client.

clients.name: Jellyfin for webOS
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for LG webOS smart TVs, wrapping the web client for the big screen.
clients.description: Jellyfin for webOS is the official app for LG smart TVs. It's a small native wrapper around the same [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) client that runs in a browser or ships with every server, so most development and features happen there and land on webOS automatically, while the wrapper handles remote input, TV-specific playback, and installation through LG's Content Store.

clients.name: Jellyfin for Xbox
clients.shortDescription: The official Jellyfin app for Xbox consoles, wrapping the web client in a Universal Windows Platform app.
clients.description: Jellyfin for Xbox is the official client for Xbox consoles, built as a Universal Windows Platform app that wraps the same [Jellyfin Web](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-web) interface every server ships with in an integrated webview. It brings that browsing and playback experience to a controller and TV screen, with installation through the Microsoft Store.

clients.name: JellySee
clients.shortDescription: A native Apple TV app that brings Jellyfin and Jellyseerr together in one interface, with requesting, watchlists, and direct-play-first streaming.
clients.description:
JellySee is a native tvOS app that brings your Jellyfin server and Jellyseerr together in one place, built specifically for the Apple TV remote and big screen. It plays media through the system video player and is built to direct play first, transcoding only when your Apple TV actually needs it, with support for Dolby Vision, HDR10+, PGS/ASS subtitles, and multi-channel audio up to 7.1 with Atmos.

Beyond playback, it covers browsing and requesting in one app: trending and recommended sections, cast and crew pages, a watchlist, and one-tap requests with season and quality-profile selection that track through to Available. Multiple Jellyfin and Jellyseerr servers and profiles are supported, each Apple TV user can keep their own setup, and SyncPlay lets you watch together with other clients on the same network. JellySee is a paid, closed-source app, though two of its companion Jellyfin plugins (native trickplay and YouTube trailers) are open source.

clients.name: Moonfin
clients.shortDescription: A premium Jellyfin and Emby client built with Flutter for phones, tablets, desktop, Android TV, Apple TV, Fire TV, and web, with offline downloads, retro games, and ebook support.
clients.description:
Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin and Emby servers, built with Flutter. A single shared codebase powers phones and tablets, Windows, macOS, and Linux, Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV, plus an installable web app, all with a navigation scheme tuned for touch, pointer, and remote input.

Beyond core playback, Moonfin supports a unified library that merges multiple Jellyfin and Emby servers into one browsable UI, offline downloads with automatic organization, ebook and audiobook reading, and retro game emulation with gamepad support and cross-device save states. A theme store with a built-in editor and OLED mode, Live TV with DVR, SyncPlay, and Seerr integration for discovery and requests round out the feature set. Web playback and the theme store sync are powered by the companion Moonbase server plugin.

clients.name: Pelagica
clients.shortDescription: A modern web, desktop and TV client for Jellyfin
clients.description: Pelagica is a web, desktop, and TV client for Jellyfin built using React. It aims to provide a fast, modern, and customizable user experience for browsing and watching your media library. It's available as a self-hosted web app, a native desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux, and a TV app for Samsung Tizen and LG webOS. ## Features - **Customizable Sections:** Tailor your homepage with sections like "Continue Watching", "Recently Added", or completely custom queries. - **Media Bars:** Add custom media bars to feature specific content. - **Search:** Quickly find media across your library from anywhere using `Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`. - **Video Player:** Integrated video player for movies and TV shows. - **Music Player:** A music player that allows you to listen to your music albums or playlists while browsing your library. - **Responsive Design:** Works seamlessly on both desktop and mobile devices. - **Desktop App:** Native apps for macOS, Windows, and Linux, built with [Wails](https://v3.wails.io). - **Theming:** Light and dark mode support as well as custom themes - **Localization:** Supports multiple languages through [community contributions](#localization). If you want to suggest new features or report bugs, please use the [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KartoffelChipss/pelagica/issues) section. ### Integrated Services - **Seerr:** Discover new movies and TV shows to watch, and request them without leaving Pelagica. - **Streamystats:** Get your streamystats recommendations directly on your home page. - **kefintweaks Watchlist:** View and manage your kefintweaks watchlist within Pelagica. ## Web Demo You can find a live demo of Pelagica web at: https://demo.pelagica.app/ The demo instance has the `jellyfin.streamyfin.app` server with a username preconfigured, so you just have to click "Login" to test it out. If your own Jellyfin server is publicly accessible, you can also use that by entering the server URL and your credentials. For production use, you should self-host Pelagica using Docker or another method. Thank you to [Streamyfin](https://streamyfin.app/) for providing a demo Jellyfin server for testing! ## Discord For discussions about Pelagica, join the [JellyfinCommunity](https://discord.gg/VKqprjh3Wr) and head to the `#pelagica` channel.

installationInstructions.web: You can find a web installation instruction in [the docs](https://pelagica.app/docs/installation).
installationInstructions.windows: You can download an `.exe` installer from [Releases](https://github.com/PelagicaApp/Pelagica/releases/latest).
installationInstructions.linux: You can download a `.deb`, a `.pkg.tar.zst` (Arch Linux), or an `.AppImage` from [Releases](https://github.com/PelagicaApp/Pelagica/releases/latest).
installationInstructions.macos:
On Apple Silicon, install via the Homebrew tap:

```sh
brew tap PelagicaApp/pelagica
brew trust PelagicaApp/pelagica
brew install --cask pelagica
```

Then clear the quarantine flag once (the app isn't notarized):

```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Pelagica.app"
```

Alternatively, download the `.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/PelagicaApp/Pelagica/releases) and right-click > Open to bypass Gatekeeper.
installationInstructions.webos: You can find a webOS installation instruction in [the docs](https://pelagica.app/docs/webos).
installationInstructions.tizen: You can find a Tizen installation instruction in [the docs](https://pelagica.app/docs/tizen).
installationInstructions.tvos: You can find a tvOS installation instruction in [the docs](https://pelagica.app/docs/appletv).

clients.name: Streamyfin
clients.shortDescription: A Jellyfin client built with Expo for iOS, Android, tvOS, and Android TV, using MPV for playback with offline downloads, trickplay, and Chromecast.
clients.description:
Streamyfin is a Jellyfin client built with Expo and React Native for Android and iOS, with additional Apple TV and Android TV support. It uses MPV as its playback engine across platforms and aims to be a smooth, reliable alternative to the official apps.

Beyond core playback, Streamyfin supports downloading media for offline viewing, trickplay scrubbing thumbnails, intro/credits skipping, Chromecast, and Jellyseerr integration for requesting media from within the app. A companion Jellyfin server plugin lets admins sync client settings, default languages, and download/search provider configuration across all users.

clients.name: Swiftfin
clients.shortDescription: The official Swift-native Jellyfin client for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, built around VLCKit to maximize direct play.
clients.description:
Swiftfin is the official Jellyfin client written in Swift for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV, redesigned to look and feel native on every class of Apple device rather than reusing the web interface. It ships two playback engines: a VLCKit-based player that maximizes direct play across a wide range of containers and codecs, and a native AVPlayer-based option for cases like framerate matching and Picture in Picture where Apple's own player has the edge.

Beyond playback, Swiftfin covers Live TV, trickplay scrubbing thumbnails, downloads for offline viewing, and Quick Connect and multi-server login, all built and maintained by the Jellyfin team as an official beta. It's free on the App Store, with a TestFlight channel for testing new features and fixes before general release.

clients.name: Swiftly Player
clients.shortDescription: A native, distraction-free Jellyfin client for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac, with a shared GTK4 app for Linux and Windows.
clients.description:
Swiftly for Jellyfin is a native client built for Apple platforms first, with iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Mac sharing the same interface and playback logic. It keeps things deliberately simple: open the app, find your library, and play, with resume, subtitle switching, and Picture in Picture handled properly instead of buried behind a long settings list.

The same codebase also ships as a native GTK4 app for Linux and Windows, built on libVLC. Its device profile declares every container, codec, and subtitle format the app supports, so the server has no reason to transcode and your CPU stays cool. There's no account, subscription, or tracking: nothing leaves your device except the requests to the server you enter yourself.

installationInstructions.ios: You can install Swiftly Player on iPhone and iPad from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806824067).
installationInstructions.tvos: You can install Swiftly Player on Apple TV from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806824067).
installationInstructions.macos: You can install Swiftly Player on Mac from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6806824067).
installationInstructions.windows: You can find the installation instructions for Windows in the [README](https://github.com/paulherter/swiftly-player#-windows).
installationInstructions.linux: You can find the installation instructions for Linux in the [README](https://github.com/paulherter/swiftly-player#-linux).

clients.name: Switchfin
clients.shortDescription: A third-party native Jellyfin client for Windows, macOS, Linux, Nintendo Switch, PS4, and PSVita, built on MPV with hardware-accelerated playback, Live TV, and a remote file browser for WebDAV/SFTP/FTP sources.
clients.description:
Switchfin is a third-party native Jellyfin client originally built for Nintendo Switch homebrew, and now also available for Windows, macOS, Linux, PS4, and PSVita. Playback is built on MPV, with direct play and server-side transcoding, hardware-accelerated decoding with software fallback, and broad codec support for containers, video, audio, and subtitles including SSA/ASS.

Beyond core playback it covers Live TV with a channel guide, offline downloads with series batch download, a dashboard for monitoring server sessions and activities, and MirrorPlay for controlling playback on one device from another over the local network. A remote file browser lets you add WebDAV, HTTP(S), SFTP, and FTP sources alongside your Jellyfin libraries, and Danmaku (弹幕) overlays are supported through the jellyfin-plugin-danmu plugin. The interface is available in 14 languages.
